en: Welch? Hey, Welch?
Oh, there you are.
Yeah, Eu? What's up?
What do you mean "what's up"?

Eslyn was complaining that she
went through all the trouble of
preparing a seat for you at the
ceremony.
I told you from the start that I\nwasn't going.
It's not like I did anything that\ngrand, and I've always hated\nthat kind of fuss.
Tika, Ricardo, Karlyn, and Henri\nsaid they'd handle it, so that's\nfine.
Besides, the fact that you're\nhere means you're slacking off\ntoo, Eu. Don't be so stiff.
Well, that's true, but still...
But are you guys sure about\nthis?
Of course. We've all settled our\naffairs. That's why we're here.
Even so, a new era of peace\nhas finally dawned upon both\nDaftine and Daftes.

Why, then, would you choose to
embark once more on a
perilous journey through space,
fraught with danger and
hardship?
That is exactly why we want to\ngo with you.

Well, everyone here has
already been registered as
crew members, so there's no
problem with you coming
along...

Hmph. Not for me to say, but
this journey is essentially a
one-way ticket to the Captain's
homeland.
We may never be able to\nreturn to this star system.
Do you still wish to go?
...Personally, I'm actually fond\nof those kinds of things.
You're so persistent! I said I'm\ncoming, so I'm coming! It's\nalready decided!
If I go with you guys, I'll get to\nsee tons of amazing things I've\nnever seen before, right!
Right! Besides, I'll be useful!
Besides, if I stay in Baschen,\nthe people of Rubarika will just\nbe scared of me.

Now that the Crown Prince,
who led the war faction, has
passed away after turning into
Thornite, and the Emperor has
softened his stance...
My existence as the "Beast\nWitch" is nothing more than a\nnuisance to Baschen now.
That's why I want to take a\nleap of faith and see it for\nmyself. A new world.
I don't necessarily think of this\nas a one-way ticket.
The Captains might wonder\nwhat on earth I'm talking about,\nbut...
I feel like the journey on Coro's\nship is something more free.
If you showed your face, it\nwould just make things\ncomplicated.
So... I'm going too.
My family told me to go for it.
Your family?

Well, mostly my sister Eslyn.
She added that I'd better bring
back some stories as
souvenirs.
I see... is that so.
As for me, following the\nCaptains is the only way I've\ngot left to survive!
Please don't say anything as\ncruel as telling me to get off!
Don't worry, that's one thing\nwe won't do!
If the efforts of Mastima and\nVerda have ensured the safety\nof the people of Onelsen,

then I wish to venture out and
gather knowledge of the
outside world, so that Onelsen
and Daftes may better
withstand any future
calamities.
Come on, we've gotta finish the\nwork we took on. Now, give me\na hand!
I may even be able to connect\nwith the future of our kin who\njourneyed into space.
I will do everything in my\nhumble power. Please, allow me\nto accompany you.

As a member of Levarance, I
also see a great need to
research the connection
between the Burning Sickness
and the Beastification disease.
If I can coordinate with Onelsen\nand Ex Giva, it would be a\ndream come true...
Besides, I must also express\nmy gratitude to Emperor\nBaschen.
That man is quite a remarkable\nfigure.

It is gratitude enough that he
accepted the immigrants from
Onelsen and the ruins of
Cosmo City,

yet he went further by
promoting their existence to
the world and striving to bring
the Holy War to an end.

This outcome is undoubtedly
the achievement of that
Emperor and Henri and the
other Envoys of Daftes.

Looking at it this way, the
legend of the Envoys of Daftes
bringing unknown blessings
might not be entirely wrong
after all.
Hmph...
Yeah, well, in a way, the person\nI'm most confused about is\nyou, Mastima...
Hm? Why is that?
Don't "why is that" me! Cosmo\nCity was destroyed, but not all\nof Ex Giva vanished, right?
There are still people there\nwho need your power, Mastima.
So why on earth...
It is not as if I am constantly\ntending to that place.

I am an organic lifeform as well.
There are times when I sleep
for hundreds or even
thousands of years.
Being away for a little while\ncauses no problems at all.
While I am gone, Lambda\nhandles everything.
Good grief...
Besides...
...Huh? What is it?

No, it is just that at my age, I
have felt an uncharacteristic
urge to set out on a new
adventure.
Besides, if necessary, the\nGrand Daft of Ex Giva can\nfunction as a mobile battleship.

As for defense, I have no
concerns unless another
extreme case like Givel
appears.
Ex Giva sounds like an\nincredible place.
After hearing about Tika's\ngrowth, I've become interested.\nI'd love to visit sometime.

...It would be best to refrain for
now. Things are quite hectic,
but perhaps some other time,
if the mood strikes me.
You know as well as I do that\nit's not that simple.
Well, I'll wait without getting my\nhopes up. Someday, then.

Well, I suppose it's just like
Welch to forge her own path,
regardless of what's happening
in the world.
...Yes.
Now then, have you reached an\nagreement?
Very well, Tika, and Rekoro.
Yes! Big sister Verda!
Indeed. This is where it all\nbegins.

It seems we can finally take
the first step toward fulfilling
the promise we made back
then.
Let us go together. We set off\non a journey to return Tika to\nher family!
Looking back, it feels like it\nhappened in an instant, yet it\ntook so very long.
So today is that first step.
I'm going to find lots of fun\nthings!
I'll help too. What do you need\nme to do?
I'll be the one learning a lot\nfrom now on. I'm counting on\nyou.
Good grief, it looks like the\ntrouble is just going to keep\ncoming.
Father, just as you said, the\nuniverse is full of surprises and\njoy!
My kin... please watch over me.\nI shall head toward a new\nworld, and one day, I will return.
Now then, shall I enjoy a\njourney through space for the\nfirst time in a while?
A journey across the sea of\nstars... it's the best reward\never, Captain!
Let's go, everyone!
Our journey begins!
...Eu, you...
I can tell what you're thinking,\nWelch. I know why you want to\nfinish this work so quickly.
I feel the same way. I've\nalready cleared things with\nEslyn.
...I see. Thanks.
That's rare.
Shut it! It's not that rare\nanymore!
Don't say that yourself.
...I wonder, how should I put\nthis... hmm.
On this auspicious day...

The nations of Baschen and
Rubarika, long bound by
outdated customs, shall
conclude a treaty of
permanent peace.
Representatives of both\nnations, please step forward.

In the presence of the
representatives of both
nations, we confirm the
disappearance of the holy land
of Asyl.

And so, we witness the
moment they join hands to
rebuild from the calamity that
struck both lands...

In the name of His Imperial
Majesty of Baschen, and Her
Excellency Prime Minister
Elaine Blanche of Rubarika,

And in my own name, Henri
Anle Henri, the "True
Messenger of Daftes," let this
be etched into history.
...I never dreamed a day like\nthis would actually come.
I feel the same.
note: prefix (en-prefix 2026-10-08): removed the engine's speaker prefix "Emperor: "

en: However, I am not so\nstubborn as to ignore the\nevidence of my own eyes.
note: prefix (en-prefix 2026-10-08): removed the engine's speaker prefix "Emperor: "

en: I offer my deepest respect for\nthe Emperor of the Baschen\nEmpire's wise decision.

I express my deepest respect
for the wise decision of the
Prime Minister of the Kingdom
of Rubarika.
Now, Mr. Henri Anle Henri.
...Elder of Onelsen,\nwho dwells upon the distant\ntwin stars.
note: prefix (en-prefix 2026-10-08): removed the engine's speaker prefix "Emperor: "

en: As a witness to our history,
I entrust the record\nto you.
note: prefix (en-prefix 2026-10-08): removed the engine's speaker prefix "Emperor: "

en: Understood.
Now, please sign here...

Well, it looks like the signing of
the peace treaty between the
two nations will go smoothly.
What a relief.

Seeing them like this, it really
hits me that Karlyn, Henri, and
Ricardo are all people of such
high status.
Still... you never know how\nthings will turn out, do ya?

You're right. I can almost wrap
my head around the Emperor
of Baschen being sent to
Daftes, but...
To think that Henri's awakened\ncompanions were the ones who\nsaved him...
It is a miracle made possible by\nthe Emperor of Baschen's\ncareer as a warrior.
His resilience in surviving alone\non an unknown planet is truly\nadmirable.
Could it be that Mastima saw\nall this coming when she made\nKarlyn's collar?
Even I cannot read the future.
If one thing had gone wrong,\nthat Emperor would have died\non Daftes.
Had that happened, a peace\ntreaty would never have been\nsigned so quickly.
It was all a coincidence.
What's with that look?

It's true. I have no way of
knowing what happened after
Tika reunited with you all in her
grown-up form.
You can figure that out\nyourself.

Well, regardless, it is a good
thing that we were able to
witness the two nations find
peace.

Now that Ricardo has left his
mark on history, the impact on
the future should be kept to a
minimum...
Well, I suppose it is about time.
...You're right.
Indeed. It is time for us to be\ngoing as well.
Hmm...
Hmm?
Eh?
Um, Ms. Mastima?
Hmm?
You sound... you sound like\nyou're planning to follow us...
You're going back to Ex Giva\nafter this... right, Mastima?
Hmm, well, there are a few\nthings I'm curious about.
What?
Um...
Hehe, now what to do. Say,\nyou... or rather,
Captain?
Eek...!
Right then.
All set!
Yeah!
Let's go.
Right.
Yes.
Shall we?
Ready.
The time for a choice has\ncome.
My, we've certainly become\nquite a large group in such a\nshort time.
The more the merrier! I\nwelcome them all!
Tsk... If I weren't the one being\nlooked after, I'd have a few\nthings to say.
Big brother! That's basically\nthe same as complaining!

Everyone here is a comrade
who fought for Daftine's and
my future! I won't let you say
anything mean!
I know, I know!
It's time to say goodbye to\nDaftine.
Will Morphus be okay with his\nmission?
Mastima, are you really\ncoming?
All right, let's go together.

Captain, do you have a
moment? There is something I
wish to tell you while I have the
chance.
It is about Givel.
I can say with certainty that he\nis not dead.
We likely won't make contact\nwith him anytime soon.

However, as long as he is
somewhere in this universe, we
will eventually cross paths with
him again.
And when that time comes...
He spent an unfathomable\nnumber of years hunting\nEvelysse.
And once he found her, he\n"tried to take her back." All by\nhimself.
Givel, who was waiting for us in\nthat rift world...
I wonder why he tried to stop\nus there.
I wonder where he intended to\ntake her back to.
Even I cannot say for certain.
But keep it in the back of your\nmind.
That one day...
The existence of Evelysse may\npotentially become a threat to\nyour lives.
